Visit note | 2025-09-30 02:00 PM | Dr. Asif Mahmud, Dermatology | Patient: Dipak Ghosh, 51, male. Mr. Ghosh returns for review reporting that he still scratches at night and has itchy dry patches on his elbows and knees. He works as a nurse and mentions his condition flared during the dry winter in Sylhet. He has no other major medical conditions and reports no secondary infection or open skin breaks. On examination: affected area about 5 cm across, BP 113/86 mmHg, pulse 83 bpm, weight 64 kg. Skin is dry with mild lichenification over the extensor surfaces. Assessment: Atopic eczema. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to use a mild soap, avoid hot baths, and wear cotton clothes. Follow-up in 2 weeks.

Visit note | 2025-09-30 02:30 PM | Dr. Rezaul Karim, Neurology | Patient: Jubayer Molla, 68, male. Mr. Molla presents complaining of brief spinning when turning in bed, dizziness when looking up, and nausea with the spinning. He works as a madrasa teacher and states these symptoms started after a long bus ride to Rangpur. His medical history is significant for Hypothyroidism. He denies any fainting spells, hearing loss, or numbness in his limbs. On examination: Dix-Hallpike test positive on the right side, BP 128/75 mmHg, pulse 77 bpm, weight 55 kg. Cranial nerves are intact. Assessment: Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to get up slowly from bed, avoid sudden head movements, and repeat the Epley manoeuvre at home as shown. Follow-up in 2 weeks.
